title: Dinner from what is in stock at home
description: Picking the ingredients you want to use and seeing what is missing for the meals that fit.

blocks.text: Someone picks a few of the ingredients they have and gets dinner options. Each one shows at once what is already there and what would have to be bought. They set the quantities themselves and choose which leftovers matter more to use up.

quote.text: When I have leftovers that need to use up, I go to this app. The leftover function lets you enter what you have then gives some ideas on what to make.

blocks.text: Using what is about to be forgotten

A scenario like this does not require describing the whole pantry in advance. A one-off entry before cooking and a way to drop a meal that does not suit are enough. The ingredients and the family’s restrictions are checked before the choice is made.

This is an easier way in than keeping permanent inventory. It is worth finding out whether people come back for the next dinner and whether they find an option that fits without new, complicated shopping; a large catalog does not deliver that by itself.
